title: Finite Hom support in product-coproduct families under Brown hypotheses
statement: For a scheme X and a commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ, let S be its bounded constructible finite-Tor property and L its localizing closure [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Suppose the Brown bundle of [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion] holds. Let K be an object of L with underlying object in S. Let E be a family in L indexed in Type(u+1), and let a cofan c on E be a coproduct. Suppose maps π_i from its vertex to E_i make it a product and c.inj_i followed by π_j is zero when i≠j. Then there exists a finite set T of indices such that Hom_L(K,E_i) is a subsingleton for every i outside T. Consequently, if the set of indices admitting a nonzero map K→E_i is infinite, the Brown bundle does not hold. Compactness is the canonical Hom-map bijectivity notion [def-pc-compact-object].

source.place: finite-support compactness obstruction in not_preservesColimitsOfShape_of_forall_hom_ne_zero; applied to the Brown compactness clause

proof.text: Use brownHypothesesFor_iff to extract a coproduct structure and compactness of K. The source equivalence isCompactObject_iff_isCompactObj expresses every map from K to c as a finite sum of maps through the coproduct injections.

For each i choose a map f_i:K→E_i that is nonzero if such a map exists, and otherwise zero. The product universal property gives f:K→c with those components. Write f as a finite sum supported on T. For i outside T, composing with π_i annihilates every summand by the off-diagonal condition. Thus f_i=0 and by its choice every map K→E_i is zero. An infinite set of nonzero Hom indices contains an index outside T, contradicting subsingleton elimination.

theorem not_brownHypothesesFor_of_product_coproduct
    {Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} (E : I → (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (c : Cofan E) (hc : IsColimit c) (π : ∀ i, c.pt ⟶ E i)
    (hp : IsLimit (Fan.mk c.pt π))
    (hdiag : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → c.inj i ≫ π j = 0)
    (hhom : {i : I | ∃ f : K ⟶ E i, f ≠ 0}.Infinite) :
    ¬ BrownHypothesesFor Λ X
